header.running_head: The Importance Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) Attached to the Tahajjud Salaah

blocks.text: The Importance Hadhrat Baraa (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) gave to the Sunnah Salaahs Before the Zuhr Salaah
It is reported that both Hadhrat Baraa (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) performed the four Rakaahs of Sunnah salaah. [^1]

It is also narrated that whenever the sun passes its meridian, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) would proceed to the Masjid where he would perform twelve Rakaahs salaah before the (Fardh of) Zuhr. Only then would he sit down. [^2]
Hadhrat Naafi narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) would perform eight Rakaahs salaah before the Zuhr salaah and then four Rakaahs afterwards. [^3]

The Importance Hadhrat Ali (RA) gave to the Sunnah Salaah Before the Asr Salaah and The Importance Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Attached to the Sunnah Salaahs Between the Maghrib and Isha Salaahs

Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ emphatically advised me never to forsake three acts throughout my life. One of them is to perform four Rakaahs before Asr. I shall therefore never leave them out for as long as I live." [^4]

Hadhrat Abu Faakhtah narrates that when Hadhrat Ali (RA) once mentioned that the salaahs between the Maghrib and Isha salaahs are called Salaatul Ghaflah ('salaah of negligence'), he added, "Now you people have fallen into negligence (because you neglect these salaahs)." [^5]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) once said, "The person who performs four Rakaahs salaah after Maghrib is like the person fighting battle after battle (in the path of Allaah)." [^6]
